headlines.title: Philip Morris (PM) Stock Looks Richly Valued After $16b Smoke Free Push
headlines.summary: Philip Morris International has ridden a strong multi year share price run, and that leaves investors asking whether the current valuation is still grounded in the earnings power of the business. With the stock now in a very different place than it was several years ago, the key issue is how much of its profit story is already baked into today's price. Over the past 5 years the stock has returned 160.9%.

headlines.summary: Philip Morris International Inc. (NYSE:PM) closed at $201.19 on October 9. The stock has returned 25.4% during the last 6 months, compared to a 33.9% return for the Insider Monkey Billionaire Index and 18.2% for the State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust.

description: Philip Morris International Inc. operates as a tobacco company. The company offers cigarettes and smoke-free products, including heat-not-burn, e-vapor, and oral nicotine products under the IQOS, VEEV, and ZYN brands; and consumer accessories, such as lighters and matches. It also offers wellness products. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut.
